title: Follow the Mudlet client's history in News
content:
Mudlet Client

  • Client changes in one place. Open News → Mudlet Client to browse the Duris Mudlet package's version history, from the original Arjinius Client to the latest recorded changes. Expand a version for its notes and follow links to published releases or historical source notes.
  • Install or update. The client tab links to package downloads and the installation guide. MUD News and Website Changelog remain available in their own tabs.
